messages.subject: PyStan 2.7.0.1 (bugfix release)
parts:
PyStan 2.7.0.1 is available on PyPI: https://pypi.python.org/pypi/pystan

This release fixes one bug involving the most recent version of Cython.

What's New
==========
- Easy install on OS X with binary "wheels"
- Minor Cython 0.23.1 compatibility fixes
- Bug preventing mean_pars from being recorded
